2607.01988.title: Episodic-to-Semantic Consolidation Without Identity Drift
2607.01988.paper_summary: Long-running adaptive intelligent agents face a structural tension between knowledge consolidation and information integrity. Memory consolidation is conventionally treated as an agent-changing operation: a model is fine-tuned, a prompt rewritten, a policy distilled, or a reflection appended to the context that governs future behaviour. In regulated autonomic deployment this is a liability because the agent operates under commitments and audit contracts that bind to a specific, cryptographically certified identity. We propose to treat consolidation not as a mutation of the planner or the identity manifest, but as a deterministic function f: M^ep -> M^sem over episodic memory whose output is a separately addressable semantic knowledge layer; the identity hash does not read M^sem, so consolidation updates knowledge without changing the agent's certified identity. We give a formal account of the agent representation, prove identity invariance through a structural lemma on the manifest's hash-input set, specify a deterministic aggregation algorithm whose outputs are auditable database rows with explicit confidence and supporting-event provenance, and validate the construction with synthetic experiments demonstrating per-field correctness, byte-equal identity across consolidation passes, and a mean 79.82% reduction in unproductive planner attempts (95% BCa CI [78.02%, 81.49%] across 10 seeds) against a calibrated Bayesian-shrunk baseline. The construction is a knowledge-update discipline for autonomic agents in which lessons accumulate as queryable facts while the agent's certified identity remains byte-equal across its operational lifetime, with an embodied service agent as the running case study.
2607.01988.paper_summary_zh: 長期運行的自適應智能代理面臨知識鞏固與信息完整性之間的結構性緊張。記憶鞏固通常被視為一種改變代理的操作：模型被微調、提示被重寫、政策被提煉，或反思被附加到決定未來行為的上下文中。在受監管的自動部署中，這是一種負擔，因為代理在承諾和審計合同下運作，這些合同約束於特定的、經加密認證的身份。我們建議將鞏固視為一個確定性函數 f: M^ep -> M^sem，該函數作用於情節記憶，其輸出是一個可單獨尋址的語義知識層；身份哈希不讀取 M^sem，因此鞏固更新知識而不改變代理的認證身份。我們對代理表示進行了正式的描述，通過對清單的哈希輸入集的結構性引理證明了身份不變性，指定了一種確定性的聚合算法，其輸出是具有明確信心和支持事件來源的可審計數據庫行，並通過合成實驗驗證了該構建，顯示出每個字段的正確性、一致的身份在鞏固過程中保持字節相等，以及在經過校準的貝葉斯收縮基線下，平均減少79.82%的無效規劃者嘗試（95% BCa CI [78.02%, 81.49%]，基於10個種子）。該構建是一種知識更新學科，適用於自動代理，其中教訓以可查詢的事實形式累積，而代理的認證身份在其操作壽命內保持字節相等，以具體服務代理作為運行案例研究。
